patch.head: frozen uncommitted afterimages bound by SOURCE-RECEIPT SHA256 8b0e7222d490a98b208dc68908ed864feb443b6465e5abb28395dc76df7e90c5

protectiveFactors: The immutable patch applies cleanly with whitespace errors enabled to exact base 1c1fa285 and changes exactly the declared three paths.

RecoveredCore remains the first recovery core; finalCore is bound to the second ordered OS start attempt/return pair, with exact two-cycle cardinality and distinct nonzero initial/recovered/final cores.
Cleanup requires an unchanged prefix, final-core binding for every suffix event, a closed kind set, exact mandatory cardinality, optional complete KILL pair, and only source-guaranteed ordering.
There is deliberately no KILL-versus-WAIT ordering constraint; independent enumeration of 5904 possible suffix orders exactly matched the declared partial-order predicate.
Current PASS null semantics, strict LOSS values, bound-credential profile, and expanded FMT/DELIVERY/build-source/model closure remain present.

recoverability.rationale: Only three acceptance/checker/model files change, with no migration, production default, or persisted-state effect. The patch is independently reversible.

regressionLikelihood.rationale: No source-visible semantic defect remains after the v2 correction, current-head application is exact, and CPU model and exhaustive order checks pass. Likelihood is not low because the changed Go path has not been compiled, formatted, or exercised on Linux.

regressionProtection.rationale: Six unchanged Python test tops pass independently with ResourceWarning promoted to error; focused positives cover kill-before-wait, wait-before-TERM-return and kill-after-wait, and negatives cover wrong core, order, reuse and KILL ordering. An independent exhaustive 5904-order comparison found no reader/source-partial-order mismatch. Go, gofmt, Linux runtime, the 31-request chain and CI remain unrun.

riskDrivers: The Go acceptance path has not been compiled, gofmt-checked, or executed under Linux.
The actual 31-request continuous-recovery chain and fresh public-reader replay have not run at the patched head.
This is architecture-specific test/checker behavior and cannot qualify for automatic merge.

statusQuoRisk.rationale: Without this slice, reports with a wrong cleanup core, reused second-start core, invalid order, duplicate/missing cardinality, or unrelated suffix call can satisfy the existing evidence gate.
